SliderProduct.PintoBeansSummary: Cooked and ready-to-eat beans for a quick meal
SliderProduct.PintoBeansDescription: No need for soaking and hours of cooking! These canned pinto beans are made with large, fully cooked beans, rich in protein and fiber. Whether you want to make a bean stew, a veggie burger, or a protein-packed salad, simply open the can and enjoy.
SliderProduct.SweetCornSummary: Sweet, crunchy and fresh corn kernels
SliderProduct.SweetCornDescription: This canned sweet corn is made from large, golden kernels that preserve their natural sweetness. With no added sugar or preservatives, it is perfect for salads, corn soup, omelets, or simply as an easy side dish.
SliderProduct.PeasSummary: Tender, vibrant green peas that bring a taste of spring to your kitchen
SliderProduct.PeasDescription: These green peas are processed at the peak of freshness to preserve their beautiful green color and firm texture. Rich in vitamin C and iron, they are a quick and nutritious choice for pea soup, chicken dishes, béchamel sauce, or a simple salad.

AboutPage.TextManager1Paragraph1: The Ready-to-Eat Food Production Group began its activities in 1989 with the aim of producing high-quality food products suited to Iranian tastes and has more than three decades of experience in the food industry.
AboutPage.TextManager1Paragraph2: Our customers’ trust is our most valuable asset, and we always strive to deserve this trust by maintaining quality and paying attention to consumers’ needs.
AboutPage.TextManager2Paragraph1: Today, relying on our experience, knowledge, and the capabilities of our colleagues, we are moving forward with a focus on continuously improving quality, expanding our product portfolio, and strengthening our presence in domestic and international markets.
AboutPage.TextManager2Paragraph2: Our goal is to build a lasting brand in the food industry and offer products that place quality, customer satisfaction, and trust at the forefront.
AboutPage.ProductTitle: Behaneh & Mehran Ready-to-Eat Food Production Group
AboutPage.ProductParagraph1: The Behaneh & Mehran Ready-to-Eat Food Production Group, operating under the brands Behaneh and Mehran, is one of the established companies in the country's food industry, with more than three decades of experience.
AboutPage.ProductParagraph2: The group began its operations in 1989, and its factory commenced production in 1994. Today, drawing on extensive experience, specialized expertise, and high-quality raw materials, the group produces and supplies more than 100 food products designed to meet the tastes and needs of consumers.
AboutPage.ProductParagraph3: Compliance with quality and food safety standards, obtaining the relevant licenses, and continuously developing its product portfolio have enabled the group to establish a strong presence in both domestic and international markets.
AboutPage.ProductQuote: Our customers’ trust is our greatest asset, and quality is our everlasting commitment.
